meaningEn: Your Majesty (a formal address for the King)
exampleKo: 전하, 소신, 죽음을 무릅쓰고 한 말씀 아뢰옵니다.
exampleEn: Your Majesty, I, your humble servant, dare to speak at the risk of my life.

meaningEn: Your Imperial Majesty (a formal address for an Emperor, used in historical dramas when referring to an emperor or a king claiming imperial status)
exampleKo: 폐하, 천자의 명을 받들어 이리 행하겠사옵니다.
exampleEn: Your Imperial Majesty, I shall act according to the Emperor's command.

meaningEn: Your Highness (an honorific suffix used when addressing the Queen, princes, or princesses)
exampleKo: 세자 저하 마마께서는 어찌하여 이리 심려하시옵니까?
exampleEn: Your Royal Highness, the Crown Prince, why do you worry so?

meaningEn: Your Royal Highness (a formal address for the Crown Prince)
exampleKo: 저하, 역모의 증좌가 명백히 드러났사옵니다.
exampleEn: Your Royal Highness, the evidence of treason has been clearly revealed.

meaningEn: The Queen Consort (the reigning King's wife)
exampleKo: 중전께서 옥체를 보존하시고 순산하시기를 바라옵니다.
exampleEn: I pray that the Queen will preserve her health and have a safe delivery.

meaningEn: Her Majesty the Queen (a formal address for the Queen Consort)
exampleKo: 중전마마, 소신이 미천하오나 마마의 뜻을 따르겠사옵니다.
exampleEn: Your Majesty the Queen, though I am humble, I shall follow your will.

meaningEn: The Queen Dowager (the King's mother)
exampleKo: 대비께서 편찮으시다는 소식에 온 조정이 근심하옵니다.
exampleEn: The entire court is worried upon hearing the news that the Queen Dowager is ill.

meaningEn: Her Majesty the Queen Dowager (a formal address for the King's mother)
exampleKo: 대비마마, 부디 옥체를 보존하시고 만수무강하시옵소서.
exampleEn: Your Majesty the Queen Dowager, please preserve your health and live a long life.

meaningEn: The Crown Prince (the designated heir to the throne)
exampleKo: 세자께서 국본을 굳건히 하시어 만백성의 기대를 한몸에 받으시옵니다.
exampleEn: The Crown Prince strengthens the foundation of the nation and receives the hopes of all people.

meaningEn: His Royal Highness the Crown Prince (a formal address for the heir apparent)
exampleKo: 세자저하, 소신이 감히 한 말씀 아뢰려 하옵니다.
exampleEn: Your Royal Highness the Crown Prince, I humbly dare to speak a word.

meaningEn: The Crown Princess (the wife of the Crown Prince)
exampleKo: 빈궁께서 회임을 하시어 나라에 경사가 겹쳤사옵니다.
exampleEn: The Crown Princess is pregnant, bringing double joy to the nation.

meaningEn: A Grand Prince (a son of the King and Queen)
exampleKo: 대군마마께서 강녕하시니 만백성이 기뻐하옵니다.
exampleEn: As the Grand Prince is in good health, all the people rejoice.

meaningEn: A Retired King (a king who has abdicated the throne but still holds influence)
exampleKo: 상왕께서 수렴청정을 하심은 조정을 혼란케 할 것입니다.
exampleEn: The Retired King's regency will throw the court into confusion.

meaningEn: An Ongju Princess (a princess born to the King and a royal concubine)
exampleKo: 옹주마마께서는 어찌하여 이리 슬픔에 잠겨 계시옵니까?
exampleEn: Princess Ongju, why are you steeped in such sorrow?

meaningEn: A Gongju Princess (a princess born to the King and Queen)
exampleKo: 공주마마께서는 학식이 깊으시고 성품 또한 고우시옵니다.
exampleEn: Princess Gongju is deeply learned and her character is also noble.

meaningEn: A Royal Concubine (a consort of the King, ranking below the Queen)
exampleKo: 후궁의 처소에서 수상한 움직임이 감지되었사옵니다.
exampleEn: Suspicious movements have been detected in the royal concubine's chambers.

meaningEn: My Lord (an honorific address for a high-ranking government official, especially a State Councillor)
exampleKo: 대감, 이 일은 그리 쉽게 넘길 일이 아니옵니다.
exampleEn: My Lord, this matter is not something to be easily overlooked.

meaningEn: My Lord / Sir (an honorific address for a mid-ranking government official, lower in status than 대감)
exampleKo: 영감, 어찌하여 소인의 청을 들어주지 않으시나이까?
exampleEn: My Lord, why do you not grant this humble person's request?

meaningEn: My Lord / Sir (a respectful address used by commoners or those of lower status towards officials or noblemen)
exampleKo: 나리, 이 억울한 사정을 부디 헤아려 주시옵소서.
exampleEn: My Lord, please consider this unfair situation.

meaningEn: Chief State Councillor (the highest government official, akin to a prime minister)
exampleKo: 영의정 대감께서 국정을 총괄하시니 나라가 태평성대하옵니다.
exampleEn: As the Chief State Councillor oversees state affairs, the nation enjoys peace and prosperity.

meaningEn: Left State Councillor (the second-highest government official)
exampleKo: 좌의정 대감께서 상소를 올리시어 전하의 뜻을 거스를까 염려되옵니다.
exampleEn: I fear the Left State Councillor's petition might go against Your Majesty's will.

meaningEn: Right State Councillor (the third-highest government official)
exampleKo: 우의정 대감은 병판의 자리를 노리고 계신 것이 분명하옵니다.
exampleEn: It is clear that the Right State Councillor is aiming for the position of Minister of War.

meaningEn: A State Councillor (a collective term for the top three ministers: Chief, Left, and Right State Councillors)
exampleKo: 삼정승이 모두 한 뜻으로 대의를 따르니 백성이 안정하옵니다.
exampleEn: As all three State Councillors follow the great cause with one mind, the people are at peace.

meaningEn: A Minister (a high-ranking official heading one of the Six Boards of Joseon government)
exampleKo: 병조판서께서 군사 훈련을 강화할 것을 주청하셨사옵니다.
exampleEn: The Minister of War has requested to strengthen military training.

meaningEn: The Chief Royal Secretary (a high-ranking official who served as the King's closest advisor and liaison to the Six Boards)
exampleKo: 도승지께서는 전하의 명을 받들어 즉시 교지를 반포하시옵소서.
exampleEn: Chief Royal Secretary, receive His Majesty's order and immediately promulgate the royal decree.

meaningEn: a secret royal inspector (traveling in disguise to monitor local officials and uncover corruption)
exampleKo: 암행어사 출두요! 이 고을의 비리를 낱낱이 밝혀낼 것이다!
exampleEn: A secret royal inspector has arrived! I shall uncover every corruption in this town!

meaningEn: a royal inspector or envoy (dispatched by the king to investigate local affairs or deliver royal commands)
exampleKo: 폐하의 어명이시니, 어사의 말을 거역할 자 누구인가!
exampleEn: It is His Majesty's royal command, who dares defy the royal inspector's words!

meaningEn: a local magistrate or governor of a town (often addressed as 사또 나리)
exampleKo: 사또, 이 고을에 도적떼가 창궐하여 백성들이 고통받고 있사옵니다.
exampleEn: Magistrate, bandits are rampant in this town and the people are suffering.

meaningEn: a county magistrate (the lowest-ranking local governor in Joseon)
exampleKo: 현감 나리, 저희 마을의 억울한 사정을 헤아려 주시옵소서.
exampleEn: County Magistrate, please consider the injustice of our village.

meaningEn: a provincial governor (the highest provincial official overseeing multiple counties)
exampleKo: 관찰사 나리께서 곧 이 행차에 합류하실 것이옵니다.
exampleEn: The provincial governor will soon join this procession.

meaningEn: the police commander (head of the Joseon police bureau, responsible for law and order)
exampleKo: 포도대장! 당장 저 역적들을 체포하여 심문하라!
exampleEn: Police Commander! Immediately arrest and interrogate those traitors!

meaningEn: the Grand Scholar (the highest scholarly and literary official, often overseeing royal academies)
exampleKo: 대제학께서는 폐하의 총애를 받으시어 지엄하신 분이시옵니다.
exampleEn: The Grand Scholar is a revered figure, enjoying His Majesty's favor.

meaningEn: a senior court lady (a high-ranking palace woman who supervises junior court ladies and serves the royal family)
exampleKo: 상궁 마마, 마마님께서 드실 수라가 준비되었사옵니다.
exampleEn: Senior Court Lady, His Majesty's meal has been prepared.

meaningEn: a court lady (a woman serving in the palace, encompassing various ranks from maids to senior officials)
exampleKo: 궁녀들의 규율이 해이해졌으니, 엄히 다스려야 할 것이옵니다.
exampleEn: The court ladies' discipline has slackened; they must be strictly managed.

meaningEn: a court maid (a mid-ranking palace woman, serving under a 상궁 and often specializing in certain duties)
exampleKo: 나인들은 각자의 처소로 돌아가 밤을 지새우지 말라.
exampleEn: Court maids, return to your quarters and do not stay up all night.

meaningEn: the lowest-ranking palace maidservant (responsible for menial tasks like cleaning and water fetching)
exampleKo: 무수리 주제에 감히 마마님의 물건에 손을 대다니!
exampleEn: How dare a mere maidservant touch Her Majesty's belongings!

meaningEn: a eunuch (a castrated male servant who served the king and royal family in various capacities)
exampleKo: 내시부에서는 폐하의 안위를 최우선으로 해야 할 것이옵니다.
exampleEn: The Eunuch Bureau must prioritize His Majesty's safety above all else.

meaningEn: a eunuch (a more formal term for a castrated male servant in the palace)
exampleKo: 역모를 꾸민 환관들을 모두 색출하여 엄벌에 처하라!
exampleEn: Root out all the eunuchs who plotted treason and punish them severely!

meaningEn: the royal physician (the chief doctor responsible for the health of the king and royal family)
exampleKo: 어의는 폐하의 용태를 살펴 한시바삐 쾌차하시도록 힘쓰라.
exampleEn: Royal Physician, examine His Majesty's condition and strive for his swift recovery.

meaningEn: a female physician or medical court woman (serving in the palace, often attending to royal women or commoners)
exampleKo: 의녀들을 불러 대비 마마의 몸을 살피도록 하라.
exampleEn: Summon the female physicians to examine the Queen Dowager's health.

meaningEn: the chief eunuch (the highest-ranking eunuch, directly serving and advising the king)
exampleKo: 상선은 지금 당장 어명을 받들라!
exampleEn: Chief Eunuch, receive the royal command at once!

meaningEn: the head court lady (the highest-ranking court lady, overseeing all palace women and managing royal household affairs)
exampleKo: 제조상궁은 궁궐의 모든 일을 총괄하니 그 권세가 막강하다.
exampleEn: The Head Court Lady oversees all palace affairs, so her authority is immense.

meaningEn: the king's meal (royal dining, specifically referring to the food prepared for the monarch)
exampleKo: 폐하의 수라가 준비되었으니, 어서 드시옵소서.
exampleEn: His Majesty's meal has been prepared; please partake of it.

meaningEn: the royal kitchen (the palace kitchen where meals for the king and royal family are prepared)
exampleKo: 수라간 나인들은 폐하의 수라에 독이 들지 않도록 각별히 유의하라.
exampleEn: Kitchen maids, be extremely careful not to let poison enter His Majesty's meal.

meaningEn: a royal command or order (an official decree issued by the king)
exampleKo: 이는 폐하의 어명이니, 누구도 거스를 수 없을 것이옵니다.
exampleEn: This is His Majesty's royal command; no one may defy it.

meaningEn: Your Majesty's grace is boundless (a set phrase expressing overwhelming gratitude to the king)
exampleKo: 폐하의 지극한 성은이 망극하옵니다. 소신, 죽어서도 그 은혜 잊지 않겠습니다.
exampleEn: Your Majesty's boundless grace overwhelms me. I shall not forget this favor even in death.

meaningEn: Please reconsider / show your wisdom, Your Majesty (a humble plea to the king to carefully consider a matter with wisdom)
exampleKo: 폐하, 부디 소신들의 충언을 통촉하여 주시옵소서.
exampleEn: Your Majesty, please graciously consider our loyal counsel.

meaningEn: I am overwhelmed (with gratitude or grief), Your Majesty (a formal expression of being overwhelmed, often by royal grace or sorrow)
exampleKo: 폐하의 깊으신 배려에 소신은 그저 망극하옵니다.
exampleEn: I am simply overwhelmed by Your Majesty's profound consideration.

meaningEn: I am humbled and awestruck (before the king; expressing extreme deference and trepidation in the king's presence)
exampleKo: 폐하의 지엄하신 분부에 소신 황공하옵니다. 명을 받들겠습니다.
exampleEn: I am humbled and awestruck by Your Majesty's solemn command. I shall obey.

meaningEn: I am deeply sorry, Your Majesty (a humble apology, expressing remorse and regret to the king)
exampleKo: 소신, 폐하께 실례를 범하여 송구하옵니다. 부디 용서하여 주시옵소서.
exampleEn: I am deeply sorry for having offended Your Majesty. Please forgive me.

meaningEn: It must not be done, Your Majesty (a courtly objection to a royal command or action).
exampleKo: 전하, 이는 결코 아니 되옵니다! 부디 재고하여 주시옵소서.
exampleEn: Your Majesty, this must absolutely not be done! Please reconsider.

meaningEn: I shall do exactly as you command (an obedient reply to a superior or the king).
exampleKo: 마마, 소인이 마마의 분부대로 하겠사옵니다. 염려 마시옵소서.
exampleEn: Your Highness, I shall do exactly as you command. Please do not worry.

meaningEn: I shall obey and carry out the command (a formal declaration of obedience to a royal or superior's order).
exampleKo: 전하의 지엄하신 명을 받들겠사옵니다. 소신, 목숨을 다하겠나이다.
exampleEn: I shall obey and carry out Your Majesty's solemn command. I, your subject, will give my life.

meaningEn: I (a humble 'I' used by a commoner or person of low status when addressing a superior).
exampleKo: 나으리, 소인은 그저 지나가던 길이었을 뿐이옵니다.
exampleEn: My lord, I was merely passing by.

meaningEn: I (a humble 'I' used by an official when addressing the king).
exampleKo: 전하, 소신은 감히 그리 생각하지 아니하옵니다.
exampleEn: Your Majesty, I, your humble subject, dare not think so.

meaningEn: I, your subject (a formal 'I' used by an official when addressing the king).
exampleKo: 전하, 신은 전하의 뜻을 따를 뿐이옵니다.
exampleEn: Your Majesty, I, your subject, shall only follow your will.

meaningEn: The royal 'I' (used by the king when referring to himself).
exampleKo: 과인이 친히 이 일을 처리할 것이니, 모두 물러가라.
exampleEn: I, the King, shall personally handle this matter, so all of you withdraw.

meaningEn: The imperial 'I' (used by an emperor when referring to himself, less common in Joseon-era sageuk but sometimes used for historical context of other dynasties).
exampleKo: 짐은 이 나라의 태평성대를 이루리라 맹세하노라.
exampleEn: I, the Emperor, swear to bring an era of peace and prosperity to this nation.

meaningEn: His Majesty arrives! / makes his entrance! (an announcement of the king's arrival or departure).
exampleKo: 주상 전하 납시오! 모두 고개를 들라!
exampleEn: His Majesty the King arrives! All raise your heads!

meaningEn: The king's permission or approval (a formal term for royal consent).
exampleKo: 전하, 부디 소신의 청을 윤허하여 주시옵소서.
exampleEn: Your Majesty, please grant your permission for my request.

meaningEn: A command given by a superior or the king (a formal order from a higher authority).
exampleKo: 전하의 하명이 없이는 감히 한 발자국도 움직일 수 없사옵니다.
exampleEn: Without Your Majesty's command, I dare not move a single step.

meaningEn: The royal presence; before the king (the area or situation directly in front of the king).
exampleKo: 감히 어전에서 소란을 피우다니, 당장 끌어내라!
exampleEn: How dare you cause a disturbance in the royal presence! Drag him out at once!

meaningEn: Entering the palace (specifically to attend court or perform palace duties).
exampleKo: 대신들은 날이 밝는 대로 입궐하여 어명을 기다리라 이르라.
exampleEn: Tell the ministers to enter the palace at dawn and await the royal command.

meaningEn: Leaving the palace (after court duty or official business).
exampleKo: 오늘 퇴궐 후, 별도로 대감께 인사를 올리러 가겠습니다.
exampleEn: After leaving the palace today, I will separately go to pay my respects to the minister.

meaningEn: The movement or procession of the king (a formal term for the king's travels or movements).
exampleKo: 주상 전하의 거동이 곧 시작될 것이니, 백성들은 길을 비켜라!
exampleEn: His Majesty the King's procession will begin soon, so the people, clear the way!

meaningEn: The royal palanquin or carriage (used by the king).
exampleKo: 어가가 지나는 길에 감히 역적의 무리가 나타나다니!
exampleEn: How dare a band of traitors appear on the path where the royal palanquin passes!

meaningEn: An assassin (a hired killer, often for political purposes).
exampleKo: 밤중에 자객이 침입하여 전하를 해하려 하였사옵니다.
exampleEn: An assassin infiltrated during the night and attempted to harm Your Majesty.

meaningEn: A general or military commander.
exampleKo: 장군, 당장 병사들을 이끌고 적을 토벌하시옵소서!
exampleEn: General, lead the soldiers immediately and suppress the enemy!

meaningEn: A warrior or swordsman (a skilled combatant).
exampleKo: 저 무사들의 기세가 예사롭지 않으니, 조심해야 할 것이옵니다.
exampleEn: The spirit of those warriors is unusual, so we must be careful.

meaningEn: A bodyguard warrior (a warrior assigned to protect someone important).
exampleKo: 호위무사들은 전하의 곁을 한시도 떠나서는 아니 될 것이다.
exampleEn: The bodyguard warriors must not leave His Majesty's side for a single moment.

meaningEn: The royal guards (the elite military unit responsible for protecting the palace and the king).
exampleKo: 금군은 당장 역적들을 모두 체포하여 국문을 열라!
exampleEn: Royal guards, immediately arrest all traitors and commence interrogation!

meaningEn: Young master (an address for an unmarried young nobleman).
exampleKo: 도령께서는 이제 그만 집으로 돌아가시지요.
exampleEn: Young master, please return home now.

meaningEn: A plot of treason or rebellion against the king or the state.
exampleKo: 역모의 증좌가 명백하니, 죄인들을 엄히 다스려야 할 것이옵니다.
exampleEn: The evidence of treason is clear, so the culprits must be severely punished.

meaningEn: Rebellion or insurrection (an act of open resistance against the king or established government).
exampleKo: 저들이 기어이 모반을 일으켰으니, 즉시 진압해야 하옵니다.
exampleEn: They have finally instigated rebellion, so it must be suppressed immediately.

meaningEn: A traitor or rebel (one who commits treason or rebellion against the king).
exampleKo: 역적의 무리를 섬멸하고, 나라의 기강을 바로 세워야 할 것이옵니다.
exampleEn: We must annihilate the band of traitors and re-establish the nation's discipline.

meaningEn: A coup d'état aimed at dethroning a tyrannical ruler and restoring order to the kingdom.
exampleKo: 주상 전하, 역적들이 반정을 일으켜 왕실을 위협하고 있사옵니다!
exampleEn: Your Majesty, the rebels have staged a coup and are threatening the royal family!

meaningEn: A secret order or command issued by the king.
exampleKo: 전하의 밀지를 받들어 역적을 색출하여 벌하겠사옵니다.
exampleEn: I shall follow His Majesty's secret order to find and punish the traitors.

meaningEn: Poison bestowed by the king as a form of execution, typically for high-ranking officials or royalty.
exampleKo: 역적에게 사약을 내리시어 엄히 죄를 물으시옵소서.
exampleEn: Bestow poison upon the traitor and severely punish his crime.

meaningEn: A large flogging paddle used for corporal punishment, or the punishment by beating itself.
exampleKo: 죄인에게 곤장 스무 대를 내리라!
exampleEn: Administer twenty blows of the flogging paddle to the criminal!

meaningEn: A severe torture method involving twisting the legs, often used to extract confessions.
exampleKo: 역적에게 주리를 틀어 숨겨진 진실을 밝혀내라!
exampleEn: Twist the traitor's legs to uncover the hidden truth!

meaningEn: Banishment or exile to a remote location as a form of punishment, often for political offenses.
exampleKo: 대역죄인을 먼 곳으로 유배 보내 다시는 한양 땅을 밟지 못하게 하라.
exampleEn: Banish the grave traitor to a distant land, never to step foot in Hanyang again.

meaningEn: Exile or banishment to a remote place as a form of punishment.
exampleKo: 그 죄인을 제주도로 귀양 보내 영원히 돌아오지 못하게 하라.
exampleEn: Banish that criminal to Jeju Island, never to return.

meaningEn: The Royal Investigation Bureau, responsible for investigating and prosecuting grave crimes, especially those involving royalty or high officials.
exampleKo: 역모에 가담한 자들을 의금부로 압송하여 국문하라!
exampleEn: Bring those involved in treason to the Royal Investigation Bureau for interrogation!

meaningEn: The Police Bureau, responsible for maintaining public order, apprehending criminals, and investigating general crimes.
exampleKo: 한양에 도둑이 들끓으니 포도청은 즉시 도적을 잡으라!
exampleEn: Thieves infest Hanyang; the Police Bureau must immediately apprehend them!

meaningEn: Interrogation, often involving torture, typically ordered by the king or high officials to extract confessions.
exampleKo: 역적에게 국문을 시작하여 모든 죄를 자백하게 하라.
exampleEn: Begin the interrogation of the traitor and make him confess all his crimes.

meaningEn: Execution by beheading, a common form of capital punishment.
exampleKo: 역적의 죄가 명백하니 참수에 처해야 마땅하옵니다.
exampleEn: The traitor's crime is clear; he deserves execution by beheading.

meaningEn: Death by dismemberment, considered the cruelest form of execution, reserved for the most heinous crimes like treason.
exampleKo: 그 역적은 능지처참에 처하여 백성들에게 본보기를 보여야 하옵니다.
exampleEn: That traitor must be put to death by dismemberment to set an example for the people.

meaningEn: A prison or jail, a place for incarceration of criminals.
exampleKo: 죄수를 옥사에 가두어 다시는 세상에 나오지 못하게 하라.
exampleEn: Imprison the criminal in the jail, never to let him see the world again.

meaningEn: The aristocratic and noble ruling class of Joseon society, consisting of civil and military officials.
exampleKo: 그 양반은 당대의 학식 높은 선비로 이름이 자자하옵니다.
exampleEn: That noble gentleman is renowned as a highly learned scholar of his time.

meaningEn: A commoner of the lower class, including farmers, merchants, and craftsmen, subject to taxes and military service.
exampleKo: 상민들의 고통이 극심하오니 전하께서 헤아려 주시옵소서.
exampleEn: The commoners' suffering is severe, Your Majesty; please consider their plight.

meaningEn: The lowest social class in Joseon, considered outcasts, including butchers, shamans, and entertainers.
exampleKo: 천민이라 하여 인간 대접을 받지 못하는 것이 옳사옵니까?
exampleEn: Is it right for them to be treated as less than human simply because they are of the lowest class?

meaningEn: A slave or serf, legally bound to a master and considered property.
exampleKo: 저 노비는 주인의 명을 거역하였으니 엄히 다스려야 할 것이옵니다.
exampleEn: That slave defied his master's order; he must be severely punished.

meaningEn: A gisaeng, a female entertainer of arts, skilled in music, dance, and poetry, who served the literati and royalty.
exampleKo: 저 기생의 춤사위는 한양 최고라 하옵니다.
exampleEn: That gisaeng's dance is said to be the best in Hanyang.

meaningEn: A Confucian scholar or learned gentleman, typically of the yangban class, dedicated to academic study and moral integrity.
exampleKo: 진정한 선비라면 백성을 위해 자신의 몸을 아끼지 않아야 하옵니다.
exampleEn: A true scholar should not spare himself for the sake of the people.

meaningEn: The common people, the king's subjects, whose welfare was considered the king's primary responsibility.
exampleKo: 전하, 백성들의 삶이 너무나도 고달프옵니다.
exampleEn: Your Majesty, the lives of your people are so arduous.

meaningEn: A respectful form of address used by servants towards the noblewoman of the house; madam, my lady.
exampleKo: 마님, 나으리께서 잠시 후에 도착하실 것이옵니다.
exampleEn: Madam, His Lordship will arrive shortly.

meaningEn: A respectful form of address for a young master of a noble household or, less commonly, one's husband.
exampleKo: 서방님, 어찌 그리 늦게 돌아오셨사옵니까?
exampleEn: My young master, why have you returned so late?

meaningEn: The household or residence of a great noble or high-ranking family.
exampleKo: 저 대갓집의 위세는 한양에서 따를 자가 없사옵니다.
exampleEn: The prestige of that great noble household is unrivaled in Hanyang.

meaningEn: Hanyang, the historical name for the capital city of the Joseon Dynasty, now Seoul.
exampleKo: 한양 도성에 역병이 돌아 백성들이 고통받고 있사옵니다.
exampleEn: A plague has spread through the capital city of Hanyang, and the people are suffering.

meaningEn: The state civil-service examination, a rigorous test for selecting government officials during the Joseon Dynasty.
exampleKo: 아버님, 소인은 과거에 급제하여 가문의 명예를 드높이겠사옵니다.
exampleEn: Father, I shall pass the civil service examination and elevate our family's honor.
